ui.guideHtml:
1. Controls & Combined Turn Action

  • Left Mouse Button (LMB): Select any unit, structure, or tile to inspect stats.
  • Right Mouse Button (RMB): Order selected unit to move (yellow tiles) or attack (purple tiles). Dragging with RMB or Middle Mouse Button pans the camera.
  • Move + Attack in 1 Turn: Every unit can both move and attack within the same turn! Unmoved & unattacked units automatically heal +25.00% HP at the end of your turn.

2. Global Round Economy & Supply

  • Gold is awarded simultaneously to all factions at the end of a full round (after all players have acted).
  • Tiles: Plain = +0.05$/round, Fertile (Green) = +0.15$/round, Gold Vein (Yellow) = +0.35$/round, Built-up tile = +0.00$.
  • Supply Tax: Up to 8 units have no extra tax. Each unit above 8 adds +0.15$/round supply tax.
